result.summary: A narrow residential street with parallel parking on both sides and very narrow sidewalks. The pedestrian environment is constrained by utility poles obstructing the walkway and a lack of physical buffer from parked and moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalks
hazards.description: The sidewalks on both sides are extremely narrow, making it difficult for two people to pass or for users with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the entire block

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk, further reducing the effective walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, mid-ground

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides limits sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Reallocate a portion of the roadway or parking lane to widen the pedestrian walkway to meet ADA standards.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility at intersections.

interventions.title: Undergrounding Utilities
interventions.description: Relocate utility lines underground to remove poles from the sidewalk, clearing the pedestrian path.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow mixed-use street with a continuous sidewalk and buildings directly adjacent to the walkway. While the pedestrian path is clear, the roadway surface is significantly degraded and there is no buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

hazards.name: Degraded roadway surface
hazards.description: The street surface is severely broken and uneven, creating hazards for crossing pedestrians and vehicles.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Trash bins and a bench are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the clear path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk area in front of buildings

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and pave the roadway to provide a smooth and safe surface for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting fixtures to improve visibility and security for pedestrians during nighttime.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a mixed-use street with sidewalks on both sides, though the right side is significantly obstructed by a large shipping container. The lack of clear crosswalk markings and the presence of large visual obstructions create a moderately hazardous environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Shipping Container Obstruction
hazards.description: A large metal container is positioned in the street and partially on the walkway, creating a significant visual blind spot for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Clutter
hazards.description: Multiple mailboxes and trash receptacles on the left sidewalk reduce the effective walking width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Relocate the shipping container to an off-street location to restore sightlines and clear the travel lane and walkway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install bold, continental-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the corner to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking near the intersection.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk directly adjacent to a mixed-use building frontage. Safety is compromised by the lack of a physical buffer from the roadway and visual obstructions created by on-street parallel parking.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A parked SUV obscures the sightline between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or planting strip between the sidewalk and the moving traffic lane.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.
